title: Samurai Sword Stage
description:
Cool and simple samurai action game!

Kill your enemies with stylish swordsmanship.
Let's kill 100!

Controls:
• Move

• Slash / Iai

• Avoid (Stamina is continuously consumed while inputting)

• Dash

• Sheath a sword

Rules:
• Clear: 100 kills

• GameOver: Fail to avoid the enemy's attack twice.

Stages:
• Summer: Tutorial

• Fall: Samurai enemies

• Winter: Ninja enemies

• Spring: Samurai and Ninja enemies

Costumes:
• 8 costumes
description_short: Samurai Sword Stage is a cool and simple samurai action game. Kill 100 enemies with your stylish swordsmanship.
